Big wigs. Bigger hearts. Backwoods Barbie energy for DAYS. 👑✨ Azúcar and Royal Flush Productions are bringing you a full-blown Dolly Parton drag tribute, hosted by Victoria Demizer, and honey — this one's a whole moment. Think a Dolly look-alike contest, a craft corner for your inner rhinestone cowboy, and drinks literally named 9 to 5 and Jolene waiting on the bar. 🍸💫 A portion of proceeds even goes back to community orgs doing real good — so you're sipping AND giving back. Mark it, tell your people, wear your best sequins. This Thursday, Pasco does Dolly like nowhere else.

📅 Thursday, September 17 | Doors 8PM / Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 online / $15 at door
🔞 18+

Picture it — red curtains glowing, rhinestones catching every light, and the whole room smells like hairspray and Jolene cocktails. 💄🍹 Victoria Demizer takes the mic, the wigs get taller, the voices get twangier, and somewhere between the 9 to 5 shots and the craft corner glitter, you forget what day it even is. This is drag but make it Dollywood — big, glam, a little chaotic, all heart. 🎶✨ You can feel the bass under your boots and the glitter already sticking to your skin before the first number even drops. This is the kind of Thursday night that ruins you for regular Thursdays forever.

Bring your best Dolly, your worst Dolly, your 'I found this wig in my closet' Dolly — everybody's welcome at this tribute. 👑💕 Azúcar and Royal Flush Productions are throwing open the doors for a night built on big hair, bigger community, and a look-alike contest that's going to get delightfully unserious. Hosted by Victoria Demizer, with a craft corner to get creative and cocktails named 9 to 5 and Jolene to keep the vibes flowing. 🍹✨ A portion of proceeds goes right back into the community too — so showing up means giving back. Come as you are, dressed up or not, and let this Thursday remind you why Azúcar feels like home. 💃🌈

Save this post — here's everything you need for the Dolly Parton drag tribute night. 📌 It's happening Thursday, September 17 at Azúcar, hosted by Victoria Demizer with Royal Flush Productions bringing the production value. Doors open at 8PM, show starts at 9PM. There's a Dolly look-alike contest to enter, a craft corner to play in, and drinks on deck named 9 to 5 and Jolene. Get your glam ready and get here early.
